derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and a derivative of G3737 (ὀρφανός);
def: to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse)

occurrences.text: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
